steps.text: Go down into the Edron Hero Cave, north of Edron (wild warriors and hunters outside).
steps.source: First of all, you have to go to the Edron Hero Cave.

steps.text: Kill the wild warriors and go down the next hole.
steps.source: When you enter to the undergrounds, you have to kill some wild warriors. Go to the next hole.

steps.text: Go down the stairs (demon skeletons, wild warriors, a priestess and a beholder).
steps.source: Now you have to kill some Demon Skeletons, Wild Warriors, Prietesses and Bonelords. Go with that way, and go downstairs.

steps.text: Go down the stairs again (demon skeletons, wild warriors, a monk).
steps.source: Now you have to go with that way, killing some Monks, Demon Skeletons and Wild Warriors. Go downstairs.

steps.text: Kill the 3 dragons and go down the hole.
steps.source: Kill the 3 Dragons and enter that hole.

steps.text: Go down again (a hero and monks).
steps.source: Here, you will face 1 Hero and 2 or 3 Monks.

steps.text: Go south slowly: the room has 2 heroes, priestesses, demon skeletons and an orc shaman.
steps.source: In the room there are 2 Heroes, 1 Priestess, 2 Demon Skeletons, 1 Orc Shaman.

steps.text: Open the box in the south of the room: the red gem.
steps.source: In the south of the room there are 2 chests open both to recieve the Club Ring and the Red Gem.

steps.text: And the box next to it: the club ring.
steps.source: In the south of the room there are 2 chests open both to recieve the Club Ring and the Red Gem.
